newsitem.title: POLAND: FORECAST - Banks see zloty at 3.2536 vs dlr end-97.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Banks see zloty at 3.2536 vs dlr end-97.

text.p: The Polish zloty is seen easing against the dollar by the end of the year and the prediction is more pessimistic than last month, according to a Reuter poll of the country's 25 largest banks.
By the end of 1997 the zloty is expected to fall to 3.2536 to the dollar versus Friday's fixing of 2.8950, the poll showed. The zloty is expected to trade at 2.9072 at the end of January.
The end-1997 3.2536 rate is a mean average of forecasts that ranged between 3.1500 and 3.5050.
Last month, banks had predicted a fall in the Polish unit to 3.1940 at year-end. Forecasts ranged from 3.0500 to 3.5000.
Banks estimated the zloty would fall to an average of 3.2765 to the dollar in January 1998 with a range of forecasts from 3.1500 to 3.5130.
